payload.title: The public knowledge files are linked data
payload.description:
As a consumer of the public knowledge snapshot, I want each entity file to carry the concept identifier, type and a reference to the Papyrus vocabulary, so that the files read as a graph without changing what the page blocks show.

```gherkin
Feature: Knowledge snapshot entity files carry identifiers and a context
  Scenario: An entity file is readable as a graph
    Given a knowledge snapshot for a site
    When an entity file is written
    Then it carries the concept's identifier, its type and a reference to the Papyrus vocabulary
    And the page blocks that read the file show what they showed before
```
